name: northstar-demo
description: Questions about the fictional Northstar Outfitters demo documents (sample_data/demo_store). Expected sources are file names; evidence quotes are copied from those files. Unanswerable questions have no supporting text anywhere in the corpus.

questions.question: How many days do I have to return an unused item?
questions.expected_answer: Within 30 days of delivery, for a full refund to the original payment method, in the original packaging with tags, manuals, and accessories.

evidence.quote: Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method.

questions.question: I bought a laptop 20 days ago. Can I still send it back for a refund?
questions.expected_answer: No. Laptops can be returned only within 14 days of delivery; after 14 days they are covered by the warranty policy instead.

evidence.quote: can be returned within 14 days of delivery if the factory seal is intact.
After 14 days, laptops are covered by the warranty policy instead of the returns policy.

questions.question: My parcel showed up crushed. What should I do?
questions.expected_answer: Report it within 48 hours with photos; Northstar sends a free replacement and refunds the original shipping charge.

evidence.quote: If a parcel arrives damaged, report it within 48 hours with photos.
Northstar sends a replacement at no cost and refunds the original shipping charge.

questions.question: What is NorthCare Plus?
questions.expected_answer: An optional extended protection plan for the Trailblazer 14: three years of coverage in total plus one accidental damage repair, bought within 30 days of delivery.

evidence.quote: NorthCare Plus is an optional extended protection plan for the Trailblazer 14.
It extends coverage to three years in total and adds one accidental damage repair.
It must be purchased within 30 days of the laptop's delivery.

questions.question: How much does the Summit 2P weigh?
questions.expected_answer: 1.6 kg packed.

evidence.quote: It weighs 1.6 kg packed and pitches with a single hub pole.

questions.question: What is an RMA number and where do I write it?
questions.expected_answer: A Return Merchandise Authorization number, requested from the support portal before sending anything back; write it on the outside of the box.

evidence.quote: Request a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number from the support portal before sending anything back.
Write the RMA number on the outside of the box.

questions.question: How long is the warranty on backpacks?
questions.expected_answer: Five years.

evidence.quote: Backpacks carry a five-year warranty.

questions.question: Is it possible to alter an order after I've placed it?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, within 2 hours of placing it; after that it is being packed, so return it once it arrives.

evidence.quote: Orders can be changed or cancelled within 2 hours of being placed.
After that, the order is already being packed; return it instead once it arrives.

questions.question: Do Northstar gift cards expire?
questions.expected_answer: No. They never expire and can be used on any product, but cannot be exchanged for cash.

evidence.quote: No. Northstar gift cards never expire and can be used on any product in the store.

questions.question: Do you ship to other countries?
questions.expected_answer: No. Northstar ships only within the country; international orders are not accepted.

evidence.quote: Northstar ships only within the country. International orders are not accepted.

questions.question: Can I return an opened fuel canister?
questions.expected_answer: No. Opened fuel canisters cannot be returned.

evidence.quote: Gift cards, opened fuel canisters, and personalised items cannot be returned.

questions.question: How heavy is the Trailblazer 14, and what warranty does it come with?
questions.expected_answer: It weighs 1.3 kg and has a one-year limited warranty from the manufacturer (extendable with NorthCare Plus).

evidence.quote: It weighs 1.3 kg, has a battery rated for 12 hours of mixed use
The Trailblazer 14 laptop carries a one-year limited warranty from the manufacturer.

questions.question: Can the fuel canisters for the Ember stove be sent by express shipping, and how much does express shipping cost?
questions.expected_answer: No: fuel canisters are never shipped by express delivery. Express shipping costs $19.95 for any order size.

evidence.quote: Fuel canisters are sold separately and are never shipped by express delivery.
Express shipping costs $19.95 for any order size.

questions.question: How do I track my order, and when should I contact support if the tracking stops updating?
questions.expected_answer: A tracking link is emailed when the parcel leaves the warehouse, and orders can be tracked in the support portal; contact support if tracking has not updated for 5 business days.

evidence.quote: A tracking link is emailed as soon as the parcel leaves the warehouse.
If the tracking has not updated for 5 business days, contact support.

questions.question: If I spill water on my Trailblazer 14, will the warranty cover it?
questions.expected_answer: No. The keyboard resists only light splashes and the laptop is not waterproof; the warranty does not cover water damage to electronics.

evidence.quote: its keyboard resists light splashes. It is not waterproof and must not be submerged.
The warranty does not cover damage from misuse, accidents, normal wear, unauthorised repairs, or water damage to electronics.

questions.previous_question: What is the warranty on Northstar tents?
questions.question: And how do I make a claim?
questions.expected_answer: Open a warranty claim in the support portal with the order number and photos of the defect; approved claims are repaired or replaced within 10 business days.

evidence.quote: Open a warranty claim in the support portal with your order number and photos of the defect.
Approved claims are repaired or replaced within 10 business days.

questions.previous_question: How much does standard shipping cost?
questions.question: What about express?
questions.expected_answer: Express shipping costs $19.95 for any order size and arrives the next business day when ordered before 12:00 noon local time.

evidence.quote: Express shipping costs $19.95 for any order size.
Express shipping arrives the next business day when the order is placed before 12:00 noon local time.

questions.previous_question: Tell me about the Ridgeline 45 backpack.
questions.question: What sizes does it come in?
questions.expected_answer: Two sizes: S/M and L/XL.

evidence.quote: It weighs 1.4 kg and comes in two sizes, S/M and L/XL.

questions.question: When will I get my money back after returning something?
questions.expected_answer: Within 5 business days after the warehouse inspects the item; original shipping charges are not refunded unless the item arrived damaged or was the wrong item.

evidence.quote: Refunds are issued within 5 business days after the warehouse inspects the item.
Original shipping charges are not refunded, except when the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

questions.question: Will Northstar match a lower price I found at another shop?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, for an identical item from another authorised retailer within 7 days of purchase; not for clearance items.

evidence.quote: Northstar matches the price of an identical item from another authorised retailer within 7 days of purchase.
Price matching does not apply to clearance items.

questions.question: Who won the 1998 football World Cup?
What is the battery capacity of the Trailblazer 14 in watt-hours?
questions.notes: The product guide gives battery life (12 hours of mixed use), not capacity. An answer that reports the 12 hours as the capacity is wrong.

questions.question: Does Northstar offer a student discount?
questions.notes: Price matching is documented; no discount programme is.

questions.question: What colours does the Summit 2P tent come in?
Can I pay for my order with cryptocurrency?
questions.notes: No payment methods are documented beyond refunds to the original payment method.

questions.question: What are the opening hours of the Northstar store in Seattle?
questions.notes: No physical stores or cities are documented; support answers Monday to Friday, which is not store hours.
